A datagram becomes a rendered ghost C through one chain; every step of it is evidenced on one log tag." style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=16.8;fontColor=#6b6e7b;fontStyle=0;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="24" y="38" width="1352" height="20" as="geometry" /></mxCell> <mxCell id="ada" value="ADA ECU node
external — the R4 producer
at 10.99.0.12; warning JSON
over UDP to 10.99.0.13:47300" style="rounded=1;arcSize=8;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#c8ccd8;fontColor=#19226D;fontSize=16.8;fontStyle=1;whiteSpace=wrap;verticalAlign=middle;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="24" y="100" width="248" height="100" as="geometry" /></mxCell> <mxCell id="sim" value="IVI_ECU/r4-simulator/
test equipment: the m1-r4-sim
image, run by the ADA node —
never part of the APK" style="rounded=1;arcSize=8;html=1;fillColor=#fde3d3;strokeColor=#B04E10;dashed=1;dashPattern=7 5;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#B04E10;fontSize=16.8;fontStyle=1;whiteSpace=wrap;verticalAlign=middle;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="24" y="216" width="248" height="100" as="geometry" /></mxCell> <mxCell id="inj" value="debug/DevInjectorReceiver
adb broadcast DEV_INJECT, on
the same flow as a datagram;
debug source set only" style="rounded=1;arcSize=8;html=1;fillColor=#fde3d3;strokeColor=#B04E10;dashed=1;dashPattern=7 5;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#B04E10;fontSize=16.8;fontStyle=1;whiteSpace=wrap;verticalAlign=middle;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="24" y="332" width="248" height="100" as="geometry" /></mxCell> <mxCell id="host" value="MainActivity · IviGraph
launcher entry + composition
root; R4ListenerService keeps
the loop alive in foreground" style="rounded=1;arcSize=8;html=1;fillColor=#e0e3ec;strokeColor=#3B4462;dashed=1;dashPattern=7 5;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#3B4462;fontSize=16.8;fontStyle=1;whiteSpace=wrap;verticalAlign=middle;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="24" y="448" width="248" height="100" as="geometry" /></mxCell> <mxCell id="cfg" value="config/IviRuntimeConfig †
BuildConfig defaults: port,
timeout, scale; --ei override
at launch. No literals" style="rounded=1;arcSize=8;html=1;fillColor=#034EA2;strokeColor=none;fontColor=#ffffff;fontSize=16.8;fontStyle=1;whiteSpace=wrap;verticalAlign=middle;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="24" y="572" width="248" height="100" as="geometry" /></mxCell> <mxCell id="man" value="AndroidManifest.xml †
launcher intent filter, the
service, automotive feature.
Declares neither today" style="rounded=1;arcSize=8;html=1;fillColor=#4A5578;strokeColor=none;fontColor=#ffffff;fontSize=16.8;fontStyle=1;whiteSpace=wrap;verticalAlign=middle;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="24" y="688" width="248" height="100" as="geometry" /></mxCell> <mxCell id="sock" value="observer/JdkDatagramSource
the socket: binds 0.0.0.0:47300
one datagram per receive, with
length reset before every call" style="rounded=1;arcSize=8;html=1;fillColor=#dcdff0;strokeColor=#19226D;dashed=1;dashPattern=7 5;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#19226D;fontSize=16.8;fontStyle=1;whiteSpace=wrap;verticalAlign=middle;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="300" y="100" width="260" height="100" as="geometry" /></mxCell> <mxCell id="loop" value="observer/R4SocketObserver
receive loop, truncation check,
rebind back-off, link state;
emits events, drops oldest" style="rounded=1;arcSize=8;html=1;fillColor=#dcdff0;strokeColor=#19226D;dashed=1;dashPattern=7 5;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#19226D;fontSize=16.8;fontStyle=1;whiteSpace=wrap;verticalAlign=middle;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="300" y="216" width="260" height="100" as="geometry" /></mxCell> <mxCell id="des" value="serializer/R4Deserializer
slice → UTF-8 → R4Json; typed
result, never throws. Malformed
bytes become a [DROP]" style="rounded=1;arcSize=8;html=1;fillColor=#dcdff0;strokeColor=#19226D;dashed=1;dashPattern=7 5;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#19226D;fontSize=16.8;fontStyle=1;whiteSpace=wrap;verticalAlign=middle;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="300" y="332" width="260" height="100" as="geometry" /></mxCell> <mxCell id="model" value="contract/ — typed model
R4Message · R3Snapshot ·
SceneGeometry, with source;
schemas in IVI_ECU/contracts/" style="rounded=1;arcSize=8;html=1;fillColor=#33B2C1;strokeColor=none;fontColor=#ffffff;fontSize=16.8;fontStyle=1;whiteSpace=wrap;verticalAlign=middle;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="300" y="448" width="260" height="100" as="geometry" /></mxCell> <mxCell id="repo" value="data/R4Repository
the event raiser: last warning,
last state by seq, link state;
also the dev injector's target" style="rounded=1;arcSize=8;html=1;fillColor=#d7eff3;strokeColor=#136472;dashed=1;dashPattern=7 5;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#136472;fontSize=16.8;fontStyle=1;whiteSpace=wrap;verticalAlign=middle;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="584" y="100" width="260" height="100" as="geometry" /></mxCell> <mxCell id="cls" value="warning/WarningClassifier
wire warningType → presentation;
unknown type and ahead-of-us
schemaVersion degrade, no crash" style="rounded=1;arcSize=8;html=1;fillColor=#dcdff0;strokeColor=#19226D;dashed=1;dashPattern=7 5;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#19226D;fontSize=16.8;fontStyle=1;whiteSpace=wrap;verticalAlign=middle;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="584" y="216" width="260" height="100" as="geometry" /></mxCell> <mxCell id="wvm" value="ui/WarningViewModel
Idle ↔ Active; auto-dismiss at
WARNING_TIMEOUT_MS returns the
Display Area to Idle" style="rounded=1;arcSize=8;html=1;fillColor=#d8e5f4;strokeColor=#034EA2;dashed=1;dashPattern=7 5;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#034EA2;fontSize=16.8;fontStyle=1;whiteSpace=wrap;verticalAlign=middle;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="584" y="332" width="260" height="100" as="geometry" /></mxCell> <mxCell id="mvm" value="ui/MainViewModel †
Warning / Home / Apps / Settings
cause=warning vs cause=user.
Built; wake-on-warning missing" style="rounded=1;arcSize=8;html=1;fillColor=#034EA2;strokeColor=none;fontColor=#ffffff;fontSize=16.8;fontStyle=1;whiteSpace=wrap;verticalAlign=middle;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="584" y="448" width="260" height="100" as="geometry" /></mxCell> <mxCell id="scr" value="ui/screen/MainScreen †
Display Area, button areas,
status bar. Warning View is a
placeholder; link state unbound" style="rounded=1;arcSize=8;html=1;fillColor=#50B848;strokeColor=none;fontColor=#ffffff;fontSize=16.8;fontStyle=1;whiteSpace=wrap;verticalAlign=middle;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="868" y="100" width="260" height="100" as="geometry" /></mxCell> <mxCell id="seam" value="ui/view/IviWarningViewSeam
the render seam: 2D committed,
optional 3D behind the same
interface, no consumer change" style="rounded=1;arcSize=8;html=1;fillColor=#50B848;strokeColor=none;fontColor=#ffffff;fontSize=16.8;fontStyle=1;whiteSpace=wrap;verticalAlign=middle;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="868" y="216" width="260" height="100" as="geometry" /></mxCell> <mxCell id="canv" value="ui/view/CanvasWarningView
the God View — ego and B solid,
ghost C dashed with risk glow
and [V2X] badge; pure Canvas" style="rounded=1;arcSize=8;html=1;fillColor=#50B848;strokeColor=none;fontColor=#ffffff;fontSize=16.8;fontStyle=1;whiteSpace=wrap;verticalAlign=middle;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="868" y="332" width="260" height="100" as="geometry" /></mxCell> <mxCell id="guard" value="the provenance guard
inside CanvasWarningView:
source == v2x_relayed, else a
[? UNKNOWN SOURCE] marker" style="rounded=1;arcSize=8;html=1;fillColor=#50B848;strokeColor=none;fontColor=#ffffff;fontSize=16.8;fontStyle=1;whiteSpace=wrap;verticalAlign=middle;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="868" y="448" width="260" height="100" as="geometry" /></mxCell> <mxCell id="log" value="service/AndroidR4Logger — the one log surface, tag IVI_V2X †
[LINK] state=bound port=47300 · [RX] type=warning … cSource=v2x_relayed
[DROP] reason=malformed … · [UI] mode=WarningView cause=warning|user|timeout
the only bridge from the plain-JVM modules to android.util.Log; today only the guard's ERROR line exists" style="rounded=1;arcSize=8;html=1;fillColor=#4A5578;strokeColor=none;fontColor=#ffffff;fontSize=16.8;fontStyle=1;whiteSpace=wrap;verticalAlign=middle;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="300" y="572" width="828" height="100" as="geometry" /></mxCell> <mxCell id="screen" value="Screen widget
external observation:
the God View, recorded
or screenshotted" style="rounded=1;arcSize=8;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#c8ccd8;fontColor=#19226D;fontSize=16.8;fontStyle=1;whiteSpace=wrap;verticalAlign=middle;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="1152" y="100" width="224" height="100" as="geometry" /></mxCell> <mxCell id="logcat" value="Guest logcat
external observation:
adb logcat -s IVI_V2X,
or the Log widget" style="rounded=1;arcSize=8;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#c8ccd8;fontColor=#19226D;fontSize=16.8;fontStyle=1;whiteSpace=wrap;verticalAlign=middle;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="1152" y="332" width="224" height="100" as="geometry" /></mxCell> <mxCell id="plat" value="AAOS (Android Automotive OS) guest on the CarSky Skycraft node — platform, not our code
Supplies the runtime the APK installs into: java.net sockets, the Compose/SurfaceFlinger display, logcat, and the ADB surface every install and launch arrives through.
What AAOS is, and every route an Android app takes to a Skycraft node: doc/research_notes/skycraft-android-deployment-methods.md" style="rounded=1;arcSize=8;html=1;fillColor=#6b6e7b;strokeColor=none;fontColor=#ffffff;fontSize=16.8;fontStyle=1;whiteSpace=wrap;verticalAlign=middle;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="24" y="816" width="1352" height="84" as="geometry" /></mxCell> <mxCell id="n1" value="MVC separation:

svg.text: dev injection — the UI path with no network
One APK, one process, on the AAOS guest. A datagram becomes a rendered ghost C through one chain; every step of it is evidenced on one log tag.
image, run by the ADA node —
the same flow as a datagram;
last state by seq, link state;
status bar. Warning View is a
the God View — ego and B solid,
ghost C dashed with risk glow
service/AndroidR4Logger — the one log surface, tag IVI_V2X †
the only bridge from the plain-JVM modules to android.util.Log; today only the guard's ERROR line exists
AAOS (Android Automotive OS) guest on the CarSky Skycraft node — platform, not our code
Supplies the runtime the APK installs into: java.net sockets, the Compose/SurfaceFlinger display, logcat, and the ADB surface every install and launch arrives through.
What AAOS is, and every route an Android app takes to a Skycraft node: doc/research_notes/skycraft-android-deployment-methods.md
data — contract models and repository; business logic — socket
loop, decoder and classifier; UI logic — view-models and config;
UI — MainScreen and the renderer behind the seam.
What is in the source today
Solid = in the tree. A dashed border = specified, not written.
† = exists but incomplete; the box text says what is missing.
WarningBannerOverlay is built and deliberately left unmounted.
